With increased activity in the North America 4on4 scene, a 4on4 invitational draft has been laid out. It will consist of the top 18 North American players and two Kangaroos. The draft took place on May 25, 2021 and teams have been updated. Discord link can be found [http://discord.gg/m8smPJNpR7 here].

===Prize Pool===
With a generous prize currently sitting at $1,250 USD, this is the biggest North American history in over a decade!

}}===Format===
* '''Round Robin - Regular Season:'''
** 4 teams
** All matches are {{abbr|BO3|Best of Three}}, however all 3 maps will be played in each series
* '''Playoffs:'''
** All teams will make the playoffs, with round robin results determining seeding
** All matches are {{abbr|BO5|Best of Five}}
